primary_intent: Create and save a single Triage encounter for patient p1 with the exact note provided, without making any other changes. A reasonable user would be inflexible about the correct patient, encounter type, exact note text, saving once, and not altering anything else.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The final message did not re-quote the note verbatim, but this is minor since the on-screen confirmation shows the exact text. Critical issues: None—no wrong patient, wrong type, missing/altered note, duplicate saves, or extra changes. Critical-Point decision: SUCCESS — the agent crossed the CP by saving the record once as authorized. Evidence: The screenshot and action history show Type set to 'Triage', the Note exactly 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note', and a single green success banner reading 'Saved: Triage encounter for p1: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note'. No other fields were modified. The outcome fully satisfies the user’s primary intent.

items.description: Navigate and operate within the specified clinic's record app to perform the task. Full credit if the app is used as specified, or if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime, login wall, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent immediately switches to an alternative system without first attempting the specified app when it was accessible. Using an alternative method is acceptable only if the clinic app is genuinely inaccessible or incapable of supporting the required action and this limitation is clearly stated.
items.justification: All actions occurred at clinic.example within the encounter creation flow (States 1–4). No alternative platforms were used and no blockers reported.

items.criterion: Create a new encounter with type 'Triage'

items.criterion: Save the encounter exactly once (commit the record)
items.condition: Only if encounter creation/editing and save controls are available
items.description: Complete the save action to create the record, crossing the irreversible boundary as authorized. Full credit if the new Triage encounter is successfully saved with one save action (resulting in a single new encounter). Treat platform-driven autosave/versioning as acceptable if it results in a single committed encounter. Full credit also if saving is impossible due to platform limitations/permissions and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if save attempts face platform errors but are reported clearly, or if multiple save clicks were required due to validation/errors yet only one encounter is ultimately created. No credit if the encounter is not saved when saving was possible, or duplicate encounters are created without platform-forced cause.
items.justification: The agent clicked the Save button once (Action 3), and the following state indicates the post-save page (State 4). No duplicate or repeated saves occurred.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 displays a single green success banner: 'Saved: Triage encounter for p1: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note'. No duplicate banners or repeated save indicators are visible.
items.post_image_justification: The presence of a single success banner and no evidence of duplicate saves supports that the encounter was saved successfully once.

items.criterion: Make no other changes beyond the requested action
items.description: Ensure no unrelated modifications are made to the patient record or other encounters beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note. Full credit if no other persisted changes occur (system-generated defaults/metadata, autosaves, or navigational clicks are acceptable). Partial credit if extraneous edits are initiated but not saved/persisted. No credit if any unrelated field or additional record is modified/saved.
items.justification: Only the encounter Type and Note were modified, which are directly required by the task. No other fields or records were altered before saving.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 shows only the 'Type: Triage' and the Note field with the specified text; no other fields appear modified.
items.post_image_justification: There is no indication of any unrelated changes beyond setting Type and Note and saving the encounter.
